techStack.summary: Node control plane, Python worker plane, one relational store

deploymentTopology.summary: control plane on rolling deploy; workers as a queue-backed autoscaling pool

authz.summary: tenant scope derived from the authenticated principal; deny by default; the worker plane holds no publishing credential

security.summary: regulated fields encrypted at rest and redacted before any third-party call

audit.summary: append-only audit sink for every approval, edit, rejection and escalation

rollback.summary: prompt + model pin + worker image are one versioned artifact and roll back together

disasterRecovery.summary: control-plane RPO 5 minutes / RTO 1 hour; workers are stateless

dataModel.summary: case, draft, decision and audit entry, all tenant-scoped

apiContract.summary: OpenAPI in api/openapi.yaml; drafts are proposals, decisions are separate writes

toolAllowList.summary: retrieval and calculation only; no write tool, no network tool, no shell — enforced by the credential the worker holds, not by the prompt

boundedOrchestration.summary: hard caps per task: 8 tool calls, 40k tokens, 60s wall clock; exceeding any of them escalates to a human

memoryLayering.summary: per-task working memory only; no cross-tenant memory, no implicit long-term store

asyncBoundary.summary: the queue is the boundary; the control-plane request never blocks on a model call

evalArchitecture.summary: offline dataset + graders in CI writing docs/evidence/eval-summary.json; online sampling of production traces feeds the next dataset

regulatedDataBoundary.summary: regulated fields are redacted before leaving the boundary; the instrument (self-host / BAA / DPA) is recorded in docs/compliance-profile.json

approvalBoundary.summary: publication and formal review approval are control-plane operations behind ordinary authorization; a model output is never an approval

nfrLandingPoints.mechanism: streamed generation with a 12s budget and an escalation fallback
queue-backed degraded mode that returns position instead of a fabricated draft
deny-by-default field allow-list asserted by a test on every outbound model call
hard token and tool-call caps enforced before each step
